name: io.github.MrGo2/icloud-mcp
description: Apple Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Reminders, Notes, Messages and Safari via AppleScript or iCloud

environmentVariables.name: USE_LOCAL_MODE
environmentVariables.description: true (default) drives the macOS apps via AppleScript; false uses the iCloud protocols

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: iCloud address, required only for cloud mode

environmentVariables.name: ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: App-specific password from appleid.apple.com, required only for cloud mode

title: iCloud MCP
